bullets.text: Side menus on phones can now collapse into a full-screen view.
Page header descriptions now fill more room before showing dots.
Header buttons and badges now fit better on phone screens.
Chat numbers and metrics now sit neatly below the conversation on phones.
Tag names and labels no longer overlap on smaller screens.
You can now open Remote Control from the sidebar menu.
Remote Control will set up its own tunnel and address.
You can now add files to your Library from any device.
C5 can now read your documents, not just your pictures.
Voice on a remote device is now off until you allow it.
Choose how long each rc device stays signed in.
Paired devices are listed and can be revoked in the Remote Control tab.
Assigning a model to many agents now works for every provider.
Model pickers now warn when a model or its provider is unavailable.
The roster now shows accurate model info and blocks bad saves.
Streaming replies now follow your chosen complexity routing.
Manually added agents no longer disappear after a restart.
The chat coordinator choice is remembered and explains any reroute.
Long model names no longer overflow the roster window.
Tasks run much faster, with routine reads no longer held up by checks.
Editing a task now shows the panels in the same order as viewing it.
Task AI swarm UI is no longer cut off at the column edge.
C5 no longer breaks where the browser cannot speak.
A re-sent step no longer stalls work that is running unattended.
Tags now fall back to defaults instead of failing to load.
Access control for sidebar restart, quit, and start buttons.
C5 shows a Start button when it's offline or reconnecting.
C5 now shows a fresh alert when a new update is found.
Starting C5 is more reliable and shows a spinner.
Analytics - Autonomy tab shows live data enhacements.
Analytics - Agents tab gets 2 more telemetry charts.
Analytics - Tools activity charts reflect realtime usage.
Tasks - a crash must not spend a fairness turn.
Backups - GitHub connects when token is set in config.
Backups - adds override toggle to allow you to backup secret files.
Backups - auto-backups will pause if your GitHub account disconnects.
C5 now recovers a stuck gateway on Windows, and says what happened.
Tasks no longer wait indefinitely for their turn to start.
You can now restart or quit C5 straight from the side menu.
When C5 is off, the buttons tell you how to start it again.
A slow shutdown no longer looks like a crash or stops partway.
